description: Per-asset DECLINES of the citation_human sweep (SS ruling N-49, 2026-09-30/10-01): a composed string is narration only if it states or grades a computed value; provenance pointers, ordinals and structural labels are not. One row per declined asset and column. Read by asset_census.load_prose_exclusion_decisions: a declared prose_excluded entry must cite a usable decision id of the committed decisions register (DECISIONS.jsonl) that declines THAT asset's column here. test_e5_7_decl_forms pins this table equal to the decline rows of the citation-decision table in test_e6_1_declarations.py. The pin of this table to the citation-decision table of test_e6_1_declarations.py is test-only: no runtime check that the two agree; the detector reads this file and the register.

N-49.rule: a composed string is generated narration if it states or grades a computed value, counts included; provenance pointers, ordinals and structural labels are not (DECISIONS.jsonl N-49)
